en.name: Pizza, frozen
en.summary: Frozen pizza keeps 12 months at −18 °C (0 °F) for best quality. Keep it frozen and bake as directed. Once baked, leftovers keep 3–4 days in the fridge at 4 °C (40 °F) or below.
en.pantry: No room-temperature storage. A frozen pizza is raw or part-baked dough under cheese and toppings — meat, seafood, dairy — which makes it a mixed low-acid food and exactly what the danger zone of 4–60 °C (40–140 °F) describes. Do not leave one out to soften before baking: the base goes soggy as the ice melts into the dough, and the toppings warm through the growth range. The two-hour rule applies, one hour if the kitchen is above 32 °C (90 °F).
en.fridge: 3–4 days at 4 °C (40 °F) or below for leftovers, which is what the published figure describes. Wrap cold slices or put them in a box; do not leave them in the open cardboard box on a shelf, where they dry out and take up fridge smells. Reheat in a hot oven or a dry pan rather than a microwave, which steams the base into something soft and pale. Do not thaw a raw frozen pizza in the fridge before baking — it is designed to go into the oven frozen.
en.freezer: 12 months at −18 °C (0 °F) for best quality. That is a quality window, not a safety limit — a pizza kept continuously at −18 °C stays safe indefinitely. What goes wrong is the eating: the base dries out, ice crystals form under the cheese and on the toppings, and the surface freezer-burns wherever the film has torn. Keep it flat, keep the wrapping intact, and do not buy a pack that feels soft or bendy in the cabinet, because that means it has already part-thawed.
en.thawing: Do not thaw. Bake from frozen, straight onto a hot oven shelf or a preheated tray, as the pack directs. A pizza thawed in the fridge and still at or below 4 °C (40 °F) may be refrozen with some quality loss, though the base will suffer; one thawed on the counter must be baked immediately or discarded.
spoilage: Heavy ice under the film or a pizza that has bent and refrozen out of shape.
Dry, grey or leathery patches on the cheese or toppings — freezer burn.
A stale, cardboardy or freezer taste that survives baking.
A sour smell from refrigerated leftovers, or any mould on a slice.
tips: Bake from frozen on a preheated tray or straight on the shelf for a crisp base.
Check the pack is rigid in the cabinet; a bendy one has part-thawed.
Wrap leftover slices rather than leaving them in the open box.
Reheat in an oven or dry pan, never a microwave.

faq.q: How long does frozen pizza last?
faq.a: 12 months at −18 °C (0 °F) for best quality. Kept continuously frozen it stays safe beyond that, but the base dries and the toppings freezer-burn.

faq.q: Should you thaw a frozen pizza before baking?
faq.a: No. Bake it from frozen as the pack directs — thawing makes the base soggy.

faq.q: How long do leftover pizza slices keep?
faq.a: 3–4 days in the fridge at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, wrapped or boxed. Reheat in an oven or dry pan.

zh.name: 冷凍披薩
zh.summary: 冷凍披薩在 −18 °C 下可保有最佳品質 12 個月。請保持冷凍並依包裝指示烘烤。烤好之後吃剩的，放 4 °C 以下冷藏 3～4 天。
zh.pantry: 沒有室溫保存這一項。冷凍披薩是生的或半熟的麵團，上面壓著起司和各種配料——肉、海鮮、乳製品——所以它是混合的低酸食品，正是危險溫度帶 4～60 °C 在描述的東西。不要為了好烤先把它放在外面回軟：冰融進麵團裡，餅皮就濕掉了，而配料也正在穿過細菌的生長溫度。適用兩小時原則，廚房超過 32 °C 時只有一小時。
zh.fridge: 吃剩的放 4 °C 以下 3～4 天，公布的數字描述的正是這個狀態。冷掉的披薩請包起來或裝盒；不要連紙盒一起敞著放在冰箱層架上，那樣它會變乾又吸滿冰箱的味道。回熱請用高溫烤箱或乾鍋，不要微波；微波只會把餅皮蒸得又軟又白。生的冷凍披薩也不要先放冷藏解凍——它本來就設計成冷凍進烤箱。
zh.freezer: −18 °C 下 12 個月品質最好。那是品質期限而不是安全上限——全程維持在 −18 °C 的披薩可以無限期保持安全。出問題的是「好吃」：餅皮變乾、起司和配料下方長冰晶，封膜一旦破損，表面就凍燒。請平放、保持包裝完整；在冷凍櫃裡摸起來軟軟會彎的那盒不要買，那表示它已經半退冰過。
zh.thawing: 不要解凍。照包裝指示從冷凍直接放上預熱好的烤盤或烤箱層架。在冷藏解凍、且維持在 4 °C 以下的可以再冷凍，只是品質打折、餅皮會受損；在檯面上解凍過的請馬上烤掉或丟掉。
spoilage: 封膜下結了厚冰，或整片彎折之後又凍成變形的樣子。
起司或配料上出現乾硬、發灰、像皮革的斑塊——那是凍燒。
烤完之後仍吃得出走味、紙板味或冷凍櫃的味道。
冷藏的剩片聞起來發酸，或出現任何霉點。
tips: 從冷凍直接放上預熱的烤盤或層架烤，餅皮才會脆。
在冷凍櫃裡先確認整盒硬挺；會彎的表示半退冰過。
吃剩的請包起來，不要連紙盒敞著放。
回熱用烤箱或乾鍋，絕對不要微波。

faq.a: −18 °C 下 12 個月品質最好。只要沒退冰放更久仍然安全，但餅皮會變乾、配料會凍燒。
不用。照包裝指示從冷凍直接烤——退冰會讓餅皮濕軟。

faq.q: 吃剩的披薩可以放多久？
faq.a: 包好或裝盒放 4 °C 以下冷藏 3～4 天。回熱用烤箱或乾鍋。
